title: SWD UP IAS / PCS Free Coaching Result 2026

shortDescription: SWD UP IAS/PCS Free Coaching Admissions 2026 Result declared on 28–29 July 2026. Exam held on 05 July 2026. Check merit list at socialwelfareup.upsdc.gov.in.
content:
The Social Welfare Department, Uttar Pradesh has declared the result of the entrance examination for IAS / PCS Free Coaching Admissions 2026.

Online applications were accepted from 18 May 2026 to 18 June 2026. Admit cards were issued around 25 June 2026, and the written exam was held on 05 July 2026. Result / merit list was published on 28–29 July 2026.

Key points

  • Free coaching for selected candidates is expected to start from August 2026
  • Result is available as PDF (marks / merit list) on the SWD portal
  • No application fee was charged for registration

Selected candidates should download the official result PDF from socialwelfareup.upsdc.gov.in and follow admission instructions issued by the department.
